data: Amazon's operating income rose from $36,852 million in fiscal 2023 to $79,975 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $43,123 million. That works out to a gain of roughly 117% over the two years. For context, fiscal 2024 operating income was $68,593 million, so most of the climb came in 2024 (about 86% growth over 2023), followed by a further 16.6% rise in 2025.
